reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team. I couldn't check the 23 May date against anything. There's nothing on Thornbury Cloth Co. in the brain, in #central-team's history, or in any account files I can see. So nothing on record backs the date up or contradicts it.

I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed this year. So either they meant May 2027 or someone misheard. I'm treating it as unconfirmed, and I suggested that whoever owns the Thornbury account confirm the date with their contact before anyone plans around it.

I didn't save the date as a fact in the brain. It isn't confirmed, and Pree's message is already recorded there as she wrote it.
